items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 58:1
items.html: The totality of the sparks that fell at the time of the breaking of the vessels were 320 sparks, which are eight kings, each containing four discernments, and each discernment containing ten Sefirot. Therefore there are ten times thirty-two sparks, which are 320. However, the Malchuts in them cannot be sorted during the entire duration of six thousand years, and they are thirty-two Malchuts, and they are the secret of the thirty-two stones, of which it will be said in the future, "and I will remove the heart of stone from your flesh". And these are called very hard judgments, because they have no sorting during the six thousand years. (Item 10).
